Hi @Nancy Barajas ,

Thank you for sending over the district and LP alignment spreadsheet. I appreciate the detail in it.

I looked into how district and LP assignments get set for your stores. They come from the location file your team sends us as part of your regular daily feed, not from a manual update on our side. The changes in your spreadsheet need to go into that file so they carry through automatically.

Could you let me know who on your team manages that location feed? If it would help, I can share the data contact we have on file for Big 5, though I want to confirm it is still current before passing it along.

Once the update is in the feed, I am happy to check the account and confirm the districts came through as expected.

Hi @Nancy Barajas ,

Thank you for the spreadsheet and for taking the time to walk through this with Peter and me today. It helped a lot to see how the location file reaches us.

To recap what we covered, so we are all working from the same picture. Region and district already match your spreadsheet on all 382 stores. The only difference I am seeing is the LP Manager on 82 stores. Your spreadsheet assigns them to Mike Ibarra, and our data still shows a different LP Manager for them.

The store numbers are: 18, 23, 36, 38, 42, 43, 50, 55, 56, 61, 64, 66, 73, 98, 101, 109, 110, 111, 114, 116, 120, 130, 143, 150, 158, 159, 180, 181, 185, 186, 189, 190, 200, 204, 208, 213, 259, 263, 269, 272, 275, 286, 290, 292, 327, 334, 335, 336, 340, 341, 345, 346, 352, 358, 363, 364, 369, 377, 379, 387, 395, 400, 403, 408, 416, 418, 424, 427, 430, 434, 443, 450, 451, 461, 477, 478, 490, 493, 503, 511, 515, 525.

As we discussed, the LP Manager value comes through the LP Manager column of the daily location file that your HR system produces. Because the change has to start at that source, a manual change on our side would be overwritten by the next load. Once the 82 stores carry Ibarra, Michael A in that column, the daily file will bring the update with it. I suggest keeping that exact name format, so it matches the other assignments we already have.

Whenever you have a moment, could you share this list with your HR contact who owns that system?

I will post the result on this ticket once the updated files land. The two closing stores will stay as they are, as you mentioned. Thank you again, and please reply here if anything changes on your side.

Best regards,
Juan
